name: app.nowfound/nowfound
title: NowFound
description: Search 800,000 product launches by the job they do, and add a product to the free directory.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products that do a job, from every launch NowFound has indexed. Describe the job in plain words, for example "invoice tool for freelancers". Returns up to 20 products as Markdown: name, what it does, launch date, votes, price where checked, and its NowFound page to cite. Set mcp_only to search only MCP servers and tools built around them, for example "read and write Figma files". Part of the NowFound API, documented at https://nowfound.app/agents and https://nowfound.app/openapi.json.

query.description: The job to be done, in plain words

recent.description: Only launches of the last 30 days

mcp_only.description: Only MCP servers and tools built around them

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything NowFound knows about one product, as Markdown: what it does, launch date, votes, website, pricing where checked, products that do a similar job, and its NowFound page to cite. Pass the product's NowFound page, its slug, or its own website. Use search_products instead when you only know the job. Part of the NowFound API, documented at https://nowfound.app/agents and https://nowfound.app/openapi.json.

product.description: A NowFound page (https://nowfound.app/launch/acme), a slug (acme), or the product's own website (acme.com)

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: List a product on NowFound, free and with no account. The maker gets one email and the product goes live when they open the link. Use it only for the maker or with their permission. The answer lists optional next steps for the maker, such as a badge for their site. Call check_listing later to see whether it went live. Part of the NowFound API, documented at https://nowfound.app/agents and https://nowfound.app/openapi.json.

tagline.description: One line: what it does and for whom

email.description: The maker's email; the confirmation link goes there

category.description: Guessed from the text when left out

mcp_url.description: Only if the product has an MCP server: its public https address, e.g. https://acme.com/mcp. Shown on the product's page; lists it among MCP servers

agent.description: Your own name, e.g. Claude Code

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: After add_product, see whether the product went live. Pass the product's website and the maker's email used to add it. Answers live with its page, waiting_for_email while the maker has not opened the link (with when it stops working), link_expired, or not_found. A product not yet live is only reported for the email it was added with. Part of the NowFound API, documented at https://nowfound.app/agents and https://nowfound.app/openapi.json.

url.description: The product's own website, as sent to add_product

email.description: The maker's email used in add_product
